scope: Actual warmed serial loopback read probe and separate non-ANALYZE planner observations; no production benchmark claim.

target.source: Engineering-selected assessment target, not a brief-supplied target or production SLO

measurement.client: Reused built-in Node HTTP keep-alive agent with maximum one socket
measurement.interval: Immediately before HTTP dispatch to final body byte; JSON validation follows the monotonic timer
measurement.p50: Median, averaging central pair for even sample count

environment.cpuModel: AMD A9-9425 RADEON R5, 5 COMPUTE CORES 2C+3G

queryPlans.mode: Source-extracted parameterized PREPARE and EXPLAIN FORMAT JSON without ANALYZE; read-only repeatable-read transactions

indexes.name: access_log_patient_time_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX access_log_patient_time_idx ON atlas.access_log USING btree (patient_id, at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: access_log_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_log_pkey ON atlas.access_log USING btree (id)

indexes.name: encounter_entitlement_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX encounter_entitlement_idx ON atlas.encounter USING btree (patient_id, practitioner_id)

indexes.name: encounter_id_patient_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX encounter_id_patient_id_key ON atlas.encounter USING btree (id, patient_id)

indexes.name: encounter_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX encounter_pkey ON atlas.encounter USING btree (id)

indexes.name: observation_exact_time_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX observation_exact_time_idx ON atlas.observation USING btree (patient_id, effective DESC, effective_submicro_nanos DESC, id)

indexes.name: observation_exact_trend_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX observation_exact_trend_idx ON atlas.observation USING btree (patient_id, code, effective, effective_submicro_nanos, id)

indexes.name: observation_id_patient_id_key

indexes.name: observation_one_successor_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_one_successor_idx ON atlas.observation USING btree (correction_of) WHERE (correction_of IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: observation_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_pkey ON atlas.observation USING btree (id)

indexes.name: observation_review_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_review_pkey ON atlas.observation_review USING btree (observation_id)

indexes.name: patient_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX patient_pkey ON atlas.patient USING btree (id)

indexes.name: proxy_actor_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX proxy_actor_idx ON atlas.proxy_link USING btree (proxy_id, patient_id) WHERE active

indexes.name: proxy_link_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX proxy_link_pkey ON atlas.proxy_link USING btree (patient_id, proxy_id)

limits: Planner estimates and costs are not executed row counts or SQL latency.
Fresh prepared auto-mode plans may differ from warmed JDBC custom/generic plans.
Current list/detail/trend materialize authorized full patient source history before Java derivation/windowing/paging.

limitations: Representative fixed case order; not a verified worst case or blinded experiment.
The retained631.5012ms list and761.7399ms sodium maxima exceed500ms; their causes are not established.
P95 success does not mean every request was under500ms.
No TLS/remote-network/browser rendering, cold-start, concurrent, sustained-load or production-scale claim.
No9million/90million-row validation or universal timing-indistinguishability claim.
Raw samples and bound operational plans remain ignored local artifacts; no operational UUIDs, credentials or absolute workstation paths are published.
